```{r load data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Disable scientific notation
options(scipen=999)

load("~/Dropbox/Medaglia_RiskBenefit_Neuroethics/Pilot_Data/Study1_Project/RiskBenefit_Neuroethics/data/Cleaned_Pilot/clean.data.2020.09.27.RData")

Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
   dplyr::select("user_id", "condition", "marginal.effect.risk", "marginal.effect.gain", "No", "Yes", 
"consequentialism.score", "BerlinScore", "conservatismFactor", "sex", "age", "education", "ReligionRaised", "ReligionNow", "Religiosity", "Spirituality", "AttendChurch", "ReligiousActivity", "Income", "Political_Party"
) %>% 
  filter(!user_id == "RU3gTWzp") %>% #we only have a single subject with less than a high school degee
  mutate(education = fct_recode(education,
  HighSchool = "high school degree",
  Undergraduate = "bachelor",
  Postgraduate = "masters",
  Postgraduate = "Doctoral/Professional"
  )) %>% 
  filter(!sex == "Other") %>% #we only have 3 subject that identifed as other
   distinct() -> data.h

religious <- data.matrix(data.h[,c("Religiosity", "Spirituality", "AttendChurch", "ReligiousActivity")]) -1
religious.efa <- fa(religious, nfactors = 1, rotate = "oblimin", fm ="ml", cor = "poly", scores = "regression")
data.h$ReligiousFactor<- religious.efa$scores
```


For power, conducting 2 groups of tests using risk sensitivity and benefit sensitivity as the DVs (outcomes):
#1. Run a model with all ideological/demo vars of interest (centered), obtain eta-squared, then power analysis at 80% power, p = 0.05, on the eta-squared from that model.

Here I use Cohen's $F^2$ as this is what the effect size package `pwr` perfers. After the calculation, I give the appropriate Eta-sqr.

$η_p^2 = \frac{F \times df_{num}}{F \times df_{num} + df_{den}}$

$f_p = \sqrt{\frac{η_p^2}{1-η_p^2}}$



##Omnibus
```{r obtain effect size for omnibus, echo=F}
data.h %>% 
  dplyr::select(marginal.effect.risk, marginal.effect.gain, No,
                age, sex, education, Income, conservatismFactor, ReligiousFactor, consequentialism.score,BerlinScore) -> data.multi

center_scale <- function(x) {
    scale(x, scale = FALSE)
}

data.multi[,c("No", "age", "Income", "conservatismFactor", "ReligiousFactor", 
"consequentialism.score", "BerlinScore")] <- 
  sapply(data.multi[,c("No", "age", "Income", "conservatismFactor", "ReligiousFactor", 
"consequentialism.score", "BerlinScore")], center_scale)

F.risk <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ No + age + sex +  education + Income + conservatismFactor + ReligiousFactor + consequentialism.score + BerlinScore, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[1])

numdf.risk <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ No + age + sex +  education + Income + conservatismFactor + ReligiousFactor + consequentialism.score + BerlinScore, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[2])

dendf.risk <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ No + age + sex +  education + Income + conservatismFactor + ReligiousFactor + consequentialism.score + BerlinScore, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[3])

f2.risk <- F_to_f(F.risk,numdf.risk,dendf.risk)$Cohens_f_partial

F.gain <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.gain ~ No + age + sex +  education + Income + conservatismFactor + ReligiousFactor + consequentialism.score + BerlinScore, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[1])

numdf.gain <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.gain ~ No + age + sex +  education + Income + conservatismFactor + ReligiousFactor + consequentialism.score + BerlinScore, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[2])

dendf.gain <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.gain ~ No + age + sex +  education + Income + conservatismFactor + ReligiousFactor + consequentialism.score + BerlinScore, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[3])

f2.gain <- F_to_f(F.gain, numdf.gain, dendf.gain)$Cohens_f_partial
```
###Risk
```{r calculate sample size risk, echo=F}
pwr.risk <- pwr.f2.test(u = numdf.risk, 
                        v = NULL, 
                        f2 = f2.risk, 
                        sig.level = 0.05, 
                        power = 0.80)
pwr.risk
F_to_eta2(F.risk,numdf.risk,dendf.risk)

n = ceiling(pwr.risk$v+numdf.risk+1)
n
```

$Y_{AME} = \beta_{0} + \beta_{1}\cdot Age + \beta_{2}\cdot Sex + \beta_{3}\cdot Education + \beta_{4}\cdot Income + \beta_{5}\cdot conservatismFactor + \beta_{6}\cdot ReligiousFactor + \beta_{7}\cdot consequentialism.score +  \beta_{8}\cdot BerlinScore +  \beta_{9}\cdot No$

###Gain
```{r calculate sample size gain, echo=F}
pwr.gain <- pwr.f2.test(u = numdf.gain, 
                        v = NULL, 
                        f2 = f2.gain, 
                        sig.level = 0.05, 
                        power = 0.80)

pwr.gain

F_to_eta2(F.gain, numdf.gain, dendf.gain)

n = ceiling(pwr.gain$v+numdf.gain+1)
n
```

#2. Run a model with each ideological/demo var of interest separately, obtain eta-squared, then power each analysis  at 80% power, p = 0.05, on the eta-squared from that model.
If we use (2.) in the grant, we need a sentence about multiple comparisons.

Here we estimate models for:
age, sex, education, Income, conservatismFactor, ReligiousFactor, consequentialism.score, BerlinScore, SNS.preference

##age
```{r obtain effect size for age, echo=F}
F.risk <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ No + age, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[1])

numdf.risk <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ No + age, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[2])

dendf.risk <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.risk ~ No + age, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[3])

f2.risk <- F_to_f(F.risk,numdf.risk,dendf.risk)$Cohens_f_partial

F.gain <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.gain ~ No + age, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[1])

numdf.gain <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.gain ~ No + age, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[2])

dendf.gain <- as.numeric(summary(lm(marginal.effect.gain ~ No + age, data = data.multi))$fstatistic[3])

f2.gain <- F_to_f(F.gain, numdf.gain, dendf.gain)$Cohens_f_partial
```

###Risk
```{r calculate sample risk age, echo=F}
pwr.risk <- pwr.f2.test(u = numdf.risk, 
                        v = NULL, 
                        f2 = f2.risk, 
                        sig.level = 0.05, 
                        power = 0.80)
pwr.risk
F_to_eta2(F.risk,numdf.risk,dendf.risk)

n = ceiling(pwr.risk$v+numdf.risk+1)
n
```
###Gain
```{r calculate sample gain age, echo=F}
pwr.gain <- pwr.f2.test(u = numdf.gain, 
                        v = NULL, 
                        f2 = f2.gain, 
                        sig.level = 0.05, 
                        power = 0.80)

pwr.gain

F_to_eta2(F.gain, numdf.gain, dendf.gain)

n = ceiling(pwr.gain$v+numdf.gain+1)
n
```
